description: This is a Java interface defining the OrderFacade, which provides methods related to order processing, calculation, retrieval, and validation in a shopping platform.

classes.name: OrderFacade
classes.description: A Java interface for managing and processing orders within an e-commerce system.

methods.name: initializeOrder
methods.description: Initializes a new order with store, customer, shopping cart, and language context.

methods.name: refreshOrder
methods.description: Refreshes or updates an existing order with current store, customer, cart, and language data.

methods.name: calculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary of an order for website or API contexts.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order, optionally with a transaction, returning the saved Order.

methods.name: initEmptyCustomer
methods.description: Creates an empty customer object for anonymous users.

methods.name: getShipToCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries available for shipping.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Generates a shipping quote based on customer, cart, order, store, and language.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a shipping summary based on a shipping quote.

methods.name: validateOrder
methods.description: Validates an order with binding result and messages.

methods.name: getReadableOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a readable order by ID.

methods.name: getReadableOrderList (by customer)
methods.description: Retrieves list of orders for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getReadableOrderList (by store)
methods.description: Retrieves list of all orders for a store with pagination.
